series.name: Global Governance Initiative
series.line: China says the world's governance system is unfair and offers its own initiative to reform it.
series.says: PRC accounts present Xi Jinping's Global Governance Initiative as a plan for a "more just and equitable" world order. Around the 23 October forum in Xiong'an they relayed Xi's claim that deficits in peace, development, security and governance are growing, and Wang Yi's eight "practical actions" China says it will take. Foreign voices are quoted praising the initiative.

sample.text: Chinese President Xi Jinping sent a message to the 2026 Global Governance Forum (Xiongan) on Friday. The world is undergoing accelerated transformation unseen in a century, and the deficits in peace, development, security and governance are growing rather than diminishing, Xi…

series.name: 'One Globe, One Community' video
series.line: A Foreign Ministry video selling Xi's "community with a shared future for humanity".
series.says: Missions reposted a Foreign Ministry video titled "One Globe, One Community". It presents Xi's "community with a shared future for humanity" as a path to mutual respect, fairness, dialogue instead of confrontation, and development for all nations.

sample.text: China’s vision of a community with a shared future for humanity offers a clear path forward. Mutual respect, fairness and justice. Dialogue over confrontation. Development for all. One Globe, One Community.

series.name: Taiwan and the UN seat (25 Oct)
series.line: 25 October anniversaries used to assert that Taiwan belongs to China and the PRC alone represents China at the UN.
series.says: On 25 October PRC accounts marked two anniversaries together: Taiwan's 1945 handover from Japanese rule, which they call "Taiwan's Restoration", and UN Resolution 2758 of 1971, which seated the PRC at the UN. The framing claims both events settle Taiwan's status as part of China, and praises China's 55 years at the UN.

sample.text: This 25 October marks 55 years since the restoration of China's lawful seat at the United Nations. Over these 55 years, China has upheld the central role of the United Nations and has worked tirelessly for a fairer and more…

series.name: Wang Yi's Eurasia trip
series.line: The foreign minister's own takeaways from his Eurasia tour.
series.says: Missions shared Wang Yi's "four takeaways" from his trip across Eurasia, presented as progress for Chinese diplomacy and cooperation in the region.

series.name: APEC 2026 in Shenzhen
series.line: Promotion of Shenzhen as host of APEC 2026.
series.says: PRC accounts promoted Shenzhen's preparations to host the APEC leaders' meeting in November 2026, along with related APEC ministerial meetings.
